articles.summary: ATLANTA --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Aug. 12, 2026-- Newell Brands Inc. (NASDAQ: NWL) announced today the declaration of a quarterly cash dividend of $0.07 per share. The dividend is payable September 15, 2026 to common stockholders of record at the close of trading on August 31, 2026.
articles.title: Newell Brands Declares Dividend on Common Stock
